name: site_audit_cross_checks_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: SITE_AUDIT_CROSS_CHECKS_20261104 — mandates SiteAuditCrossChecks@v1, the checks the site crawl cannot make on its own
(SPEC_SITE_AUDIT_AUTOREMEDIATE_LOOP_20261104 piece 5, plus the §6 amendment): now-price against the served quote,
verdict against its price, one figure across surfaces, and per-card completeness — a TOP-list card missing a
technical or a CIO thesis with an as_of is P1. The crawl and these checks share REQUIRED_TECHNICAL and TOP_LISTS so
'complete' has one definition. Pure: dicts in, findings out.
